1.body:
Hi Jithin,

I saw your UI/UX Designer opening on LinkedIn, and I am drawn to how Sysnora builds scalable enterprise web and mobile applications for manufacturing and operational environments.

During my UI/UX internship at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed findings directly back into user flows and interface usability, collaborating with developers on design handoffs. At Ascent Business Solutions, I also built reusable design systems that cut turnaround time for digital and print collateral.

For a view into my approach on enterprise tools, my Bounceless case study demonstrates structured problem-solving for accurate email verification at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to discuss how my background fits your team?

Ananya

Hello,

I applied for the UI/UX Designer role on LinkedIn, and noticed your focus on delivering high quality digital and print media across diverse industries.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable design systems and templates that reduced repetitive work. During my earlier role at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated those findings directly into improved user flows.

My Bounceless case study, which highlights a cleaner verification experience for teams handling email lists, demonstrates how I approach B2B workflows: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune for this onsite position. Could we schedule a brief fifteen-minute call next week to review one of my case studies?

Ananya
